title: Design System: Cohamy public homepage and shared footer

footer-detail.purpose: Every public-footer text element retains one Manrope size across viewports.

footer-heading.purpose: Weight distinguishes headings and the legal company name without changing family or size.

components.name: Footer Policy Navigation

components.css: .ds-footer-policies { background:#2c1914; color:#e0cfbd; font-family:var(--font-manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.65; padding:24px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-footer-policies h2 { color:#f0e6d5; font-family:inherit; font-size:inherit; line-height:inherit; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 20px; } .ds-footer-policies ul { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; } .ds-footer-policies a { color:inherit; display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; padding-block:7px; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-footer-policies a:hover { color:#edbe39; text-decoration:underline; } .ds-footer-policies a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #edbe39; outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-footer-company { background:#2c1914; color:#e0cfbd; font-family:var(--font-manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.65; padding:24px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-footer-company h2 { color:#f0e6d5; font-family:inherit; font-size:inherit; line-height:inherit; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 20px; } .ds-footer-company p,.ds-footer-company dl,.ds-footer-company dd { margin:0; } .ds-footer-company .ds-footer-company-name { color:#f0e6d5; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:16px; } .ds-footer-company dl>div { margin-top:10px; } .ds-footer-company dt,.ds-footer-company dd { display:inline; } .ds-footer-company dt { margin-right:5px; } .ds-footer-company-address dt,.ds-footer-company-address dd { display:block; } .ds-footer-company address { font-style:normal; }

narrative.overview: "Cacao Scenes" is the visual world selected as direction C. Original Cohamy product and exhibition photographs lead the page; warm paper carries product selection and article links, while cacao carries the shell and action scenes. Strong serif headings and simple gold actions keep the product legible within the photographs.
keyCharacteristics: Original product photographs and the original transparent gold wordmark.
Cacao and paper surfaces with a compact gold action vocabulary.
Playfair Display headings paired with Manrope controls and supporting text.
Open photo articles, fine rules and underlined text links.
Responsive scene crops and a compact mobile shell.

rules.name: Shared Footer Type
rules.body: Keep every footer heading, link, fact and copyright line at the `footer-detail` size and family on every viewport. Use the `footer-heading` weight for headings and the legal name, and weight (600) for contact labels; no mobile size reduction applies.
